sources.reads: ipget[cir] literal-name call census over modules/B2.5/src/**

rules.default_display: per-entry `default` = the pinned inventory row's default VERBATIM (usable values and 'See description' prose alike; null stays null; unknown_to_inventory names carry NO default key; display only, never re-compared, vs_default stays the vs_default rules; join over the indexed switches: 134 usable / 33 prose-or-null / 0 missing
rules.defaults: absent keys are never ipsetc-ed, the consumer default survives (b2mnds.F:234-246; ipgetc no-action b2mod_ipmain.F:140-141): absent == not set, never unknown
rules.effective_deck: whole-file shadowing, never key-merged: vpath %.dat .:baserundir searches the run dir first, then the family baserun (SOLPS-ITER/runs/Makefile:131; recipe cp $^ :192,194,196)
rules.family_decks: the baserun/b2mn.dat of each family, parsed once with the same scan: the BASE the run pages' vs-base delta reads (site-side, never re-parsed from disk); a family without a baserun dir carries no entry: every member then runs its own deck whole
rules.syntax: post-*endphy scan only (b2mnds.F:156/:172, b2rfcp.F:317); comment iff line[0] in *!# or blank (is_comment.F:6-9); switch lines are quote-led after space/tab strip (strip_spaces.F:11); list-directed 2-token read (b2mnds.F:240); names lowercased (chcase b2mod_ipmain.F:67-68); values verbatim (:96); last occurrence wins (:83-87)
rules.vs_default: strip both sides (inventory defaults unquoted from their b2input.xml form); both sides Fortran reals (D/d->E, e32.0 ipgetr.F:22) -> numeric equality; else exact string equality
